title: 19-Round Attack on RECTANGLE
summary: An improved differential attack covers 18 rounds of RECTANGLE; constructing a 19-round attack through stronger key-guessing optimization remains open.

formal_statement.body: Develop a 19-round attack on $\mathrm{RECTANGLE}$ by designing a new attack using the key-guessing-improvement framework and further optimizing its key-guessing complexity, rather than retaining the simplicity-oriented design choices of the existing applications.

scope.domain: Differential cryptanalysis of the RECTANGLE block cipher using key-guessing improvements.
parameters: Round count — attack coverage, with 19 rounds as the target
Key-guessing complexity — the optimization objective for extending the attack
scope.unresolved_remainder: Design a new attack covering 19 rounds of RECTANGLE by further optimizing key-guessing complexity instead of retaining simplicity-oriented design choices.

progress.summary: The source reports an improved differential attack on 18-round RECTANGLE and expects a 19-round attack to be within reach. It calls for a new attack with more aggressively optimized key guessing.
citation_labels: Marek Broll et al., Generic Framework for Key-Guessing Improvements
